candidate_config: native_colour.Config defaults, enabled explicitly true; log and linear differ only by representation
frame_order: original frame_indices, once, no looping, no pre-window candidate state
lobe_domain: diffuse and specular physical linear RGB independently, before unknown final game remodulation
baseline_masks: inventory.frozen_support computed from original arrays only, plus a fixed 3px crop halo for quality metrics
denominator: max(original raw RR Rec709 luminance,1e-6) per lobe/frame; no candidate-dependent masks or denominators
temporal_pairs: origin-aware full-render-UV ideal CPU bilinear; require all previous subset samples, finite bounds, matching original depth within2%, original normal dot>=0.9; frame0 excluded
target_proxy: current-frame input low-band chroma is an observation/proxy, not converged truth
metrics: luma error in selected lobe physical domain
controls: audited B4 math applied independently to each lobe with proposed exact-word gate
baseline_adapter_caveat: B4 and C8 native per-lobe use is a CPU counterfactual, not an existing native route or full RR rerun; ideal portable sampler remains unchanged
claim_boundary: Observed clip metric changes cannot establish correct trail removal, semantic noise rejection, or displayed composite luminance
visualization: same frame/crop/aspect, per-lobe BASE-derived exposure reused for every column; no final game appearance claim
